entry.name: favorites
entry.label: The pinned apps, in order, as desktop entry IDs.

entry.name: showRecentlyAdded
entry.label: Whether Recommended lists apps installed in the last few days. Settings, Personalisation, Start, changes it.

entry.name: showRecentFiles
entry.label: Whether Recommended lists recently opened files. Settings, Personalisation, Start, changes it.

entry.name: layout
entry.label: How Start shares its space: morePins (three rows of pinned apps), default (two) or moreRecommendations (one). Settings, Personalisation, Start, changes it.

entry.name: folders
entry.label: The shortcuts next to the power button: settings, files, documents, downloads, music, pictures, videos, network and personal. Settings, Personalisation, Start, changes them.

entry.name: pinFolders
entry.label: The folders of pinned apps, as JSON: each folder's key with its name and its apps' desktop entry IDs. A folder's place among the pinned apps is a folder:key entry in favorites.

entry.name: allAppsView
entry.label: How All apps lists the apps: list (by letter), grid or category.

entry.name: recentSearches
entry.label: The last searches that opened something, newest first, shown before anything is typed.

entry.name: getStartedHidden
entry.label: Whether the Get started suggestions under Recommended are hidden.
